name: STRIKELINE: Shelf Combat Parlay Exchange S3
description: A decentralized Shelf-based parlay betting operation running out of converted drainage infrastructure in the Eastwall district, STRIKELINE lets bettors chain up to seven fight outcomes across multiple underground circuits for multiplied payouts. Operated by the Gutwall Syndicate's financial arm, it uses mesh-networked dead drops and BCI-whisper payments to avoid Meridian Enforcement sweeps. Bettors are known to stake everything from synth-protein rations to chrome components, with some parlay chains reaching Φ 40,000 in theoretical payout.
story_hooks: A bettor holds a six-leg parlay ticket worth Φ 38,000 — and the seventh fighter just sold out to the Syndicate.
A Meridian Enforcement detective is quietly working STRIKELINE herself, using winnings to fund an off-books investigation.
Someone is systematically winning every long parlay for three months straight — either a BCI exploit, inside information, or something stranger.
